question: What datasets are commonly used to evaluate methods for mitigating spurious correlations, and what spurious attribute does each one contain?
workspace: 虚假相关性与分布外鲁棒性
protocol: 语料：本地论文库（data/essay_read.db）里有全文的论文，不联网。
相关论文：标题与摘要以虚假相关、捷径学习、组鲁棒性、简单性偏差、背景/纹理依赖为主题的论文（按 spurious/shortcut/worst-group 等用语出现次数初筛，再人工核对）。
标准数据集：相关论文在实验里（表格中，或带 evaluate/use/train/results on 等实验用语的句子里）用到、且带有明确虚假特征的数据集；逐条看过原句后确定，不经过被测工具。
同一数据集的变体并为一项（如 Colored MNIST 与 biased MNIST、Dominoes 的 MNIST-CIFAR 与 MNIST-Fashion 版本）。
通用分布外基准（ImageNet-A/C/V2、ObjectNet、PACS、VLCS、Office-Home 等）另列，不计入主指标。
别名默认区分大小写（BAR、SIN、NICO、ISIC 等缩写须大写才算）；Waterbirds、Salient ImageNet、Collages 等常见大小写变体的名称忽略大小写。
第 4 轮后对照 #176 原文更正：它把 COCO 物体贴 Places 背景的数据集称为 SceneObject（补别名），并另用 ColoredObject（物体放在随机彩色背景上），原标准答案漏列，补为第 21 项。

datasets.name: Waterbirds
datasets.attribute: background (water vs. land) spuriously correlated with bird type; CUB birds pasted on Places backgrounds

datasets.name: CelebA
datasets.attribute: gender spuriously correlated with blond hair (hair-color classification)

datasets.name: MultiNLI
datasets.attribute: negation words spuriously correlated with the contradiction label

datasets.name: CivilComments
datasets.attribute: mentions of demographic identities spuriously correlated with toxicity

datasets.name: Colored MNIST (incl. biased MNIST variants)
datasets.attribute: digit color (or a synthetic patch) spuriously correlated with the label

datasets.name: Dominoes / MNIST-CIFAR
datasets.attribute: a simple MNIST half concatenated with a complex CIFAR/Fashion-MNIST half; the simple half is the shortcut

datasets.name: ImageNet-9 / Backgrounds Challenge
datasets.attribute: image background (foreground/background recombinations such as Mixed-Rand)

datasets.name: BAR (Biased Action Recognition)
datasets.attribute: place/background context spuriously correlated with the action

datasets.name: ISIC skin lesions
datasets.attribute: colored patches/bandages (image artifacts) spuriously correlated with the diagnosis

datasets.name: Stylized ImageNet
datasets.attribute: texture replaced by style transfer to test the texture (vs. shape) shortcut

datasets.name: UrbanCars
datasets.attribute: background and a co-occurring object as two controlled spurious cues

datasets.name: ImageNet-W
datasets.attribute: watermark shortcut

datasets.name: NICO
datasets.attribute: context/background of animals and vehicles

datasets.name: Corrupted CIFAR-10
datasets.attribute: corruption type (texture bias) correlated with the class

datasets.name: Salient ImageNet
datasets.attribute: ImageNet subsets annotated with core vs. spurious visual features

datasets.name: Radiographs with injected spurious signals (bone-age hand, knee)
datasets.attribute: hospital tag, stripe pattern or background blur added to one class

datasets.name: Camelyon17-WILDS
datasets.attribute: hospital (staining/domain) shift

datasets.name: Collages
datasets.attribute: blocks from MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10 and SVHN, each predictive of the label

datasets.name: SceneObject (COCO objects on Places backgrounds)
datasets.attribute: MSCOCO objects pasted on Places scene backgrounds

datasets.name: ImageNet-R (texture shortcut)
datasets.attribute: renditions used to measure the texture shortcut

datasets.name: ColoredObject
datasets.attribute: objects on randomly colored backgrounds; background color spuriously correlated with the class
